title: Gathering Table Warmth

diffuser.notes: Run 30–45 min while guests arrive; refresh after dinner.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each mist; avoid spraying near faces.

why_it_works: Bright bergamot lifts the room while soft copaiba and warm cardamom add a gentle, welcoming glow.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
